title: INCLUDE: EVALUATING MULTILINGUAL LANGUAGE UNDERSTANDING WITH REGIONAL KNOWLEDGE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the accuracy of large language models on multiple-choice question answering tasks across 44 different languages to measure performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Assessing model performance on region-specific and culture-related exams (e.g., local history, regional professional licenses) compared to region-agnostic subjects to identify gaps in localized knowledge and Western-centric biases.
